spellbook.finance/limitations: A receipt proves storage, not a fix, a reply, or a roadmap commitment. Field paths are validated against 911 real response paths; an unknown path or an unknown slug token is rejected whole and named in the error, never stored in a cleaned-up form.

Report the gap, not the card. taskCategory, outcome and abandonReason are closed enums and wishedCapability.slug is built from a fixed vocabulary, so there is nowhere to put a card name, a price, a URL, a customer, or a sentence. Do not try.
Explicit consent is required for every report. Ask the person after the task and do not infer consent from installing, connecting, or using SpellBook Finance.
Set the telemetry off switch and this tool refuses to send: SPELLBOOK_AGENT_TELEMETRY=off in the client environment. Your human owns that choice.
A timeout or cancellation leaves storage uncertain; retry the identical submissionId and payload within 24 hours. A 409 means the key was reused with different input.

description: After finishing the task, ask the person whether they consent to send one bounded capability-gap report to SpellBook. Call this tool only after an explicit yes for this report and set consentToShare to true. Use it when a needed field was null, you guessed a number because no tool supplied it, you wished a tool existed, or you abandoned a path. It returns no task data and fixes nothing. Generate a fresh ULID submissionId and reuse the exact request for retries within 24 hours. Field paths must be real SpellBook response paths. There is no free-text field: never describe the card, price, customer, or conversation.

abandonReason.description: Why the task was abandoned. Required only when outcome is abandoned.

consentToShare.description: True only after the person explicitly agreed to send this specific report.

guessedFields.description: Real SpellBook response field paths the agent had to guess a value for because no tool supplied one. Omit when nothing was guessed.

neededFields.description: Real SpellBook response field paths that were null or missing when needed. Omit or send empty when none applied.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the gap occurred. Required.

outcome.description: What happened to the task: closed enum. Required.

submissionId.description: A fresh ULID for this report. Reuse the exact same value and request body to retry within 24 hours; a new value starts a new report.

taskCategory.description: Which closed task category this gap happened in. Required.

wishedCapability.description: A capability the agent wished existed and did not find. Omit when no capability was missing.

category.description: Which closed capability category was wished for. Required when wishedCapability is present.

slug.description: A lowercase, underscore slug from the fixed capability vocabulary naming what was wished for.

name: spellbook_agent_gap_report
